text:
Maya: PulseBridge just sent their vendor security questionnaire and a short DPA request. sharing the form here: https://redwood-docs.internal/sheets/pulsebridge-q1 (they uploaded a PDF too)
Ben: can you drop the data flow diagram they attached? need to know if logs/PII go to our hosted tier or dedicated pool.
PulseBridge - Onboarding: attaching DFDiagram_v2.pdf now. most customer data is app-level identifiers and health metrics, no raw PHI.
Maya: got it. I copied answers into our answer sheet and highlighted rows that need Sec/Legal review. sheet: `s3://redwood-shared/pulsebridge/q-responses.xlsx`
Arjun: quick triage: SOC2 scope? if they want audit evidence on ingestion and storage we should mark SOC2 as in-scope. key items to confirm: 1) encryption at rest (KMS BYOK?), 2) key rotation policy, 3) network isolation (VPC), 4) retention policy + deletion workflow, 5) subprocessors list, 6) incident response SLA. also ask if they require HSM-backed keys (HSM vs cloud KMS).
Ben: note: we can offer Redwood Private (VPC + customer KMS) or Dedicated with isolated pools. suggested text for form: "Redwood supports VPC deployments and customer-managed KMS (BYOK)." I'll paste a short blurb into the sheet.
Lena: need to see DPA redlines. any export controls / cross-border data requests? also check liability caps requested. flagging row 42 for legal review.
Maya: FYI procurement mentioned a hard renewal decision tied to SOC2 attestation by their contract review in 8 weeks — potential renewal risk if attestation not demonstrable. tagging enablement for a pre-sales checklist.
Maya: action items: @Arjun please fill security answers in the sheet by EOD Wed; @Lena please review DPA redlines and call out any unacceptable clauses; @Ben provide the one-paragraph deployment note and default subprocessor list.
Arjun: on it. I'll add answers and paste example KMS config snippet:
```
KMS: aws-kms (alias/redwood-pulse-<env>), rotation=90d, access=restricted to infra-role
```
Arjun: also FYI: we'll recommend retention 90 days for analytics, 7 days for raw ingestion unless customer selects longer.
Lena: I'll take DPA first pass tomorrow AM and add comments in the doc.
PulseBridge - Onboarding: thanks all. if you need any extra logs for SOC2 scope we can provide sample event streams.
docusign-bot: PulseBridge uploaded SOW_v1_signed.pdf to /contracts/pulsebridge/ — not a security doc but FYI. :white_check_mark:
